payload.title: Realtime calls (chat + video): WebRTC P2P, SFU adapter, call control plane, E2EE
payload.description:
Entire media plane from internal/specs/2026-05-09-frick-chat-video-calls-design.md is unbuilt — schema fixtures (CallRoom, CallInvite, CallEventStream, WebRTCSignal) exist in packages/protocol but there is no runtime/client implementation.

Sub-areas:
- P2P WebRTC one-to-one calls over the existing signal layer (spec:267-268, 435, 451).
- MediaPlaneAdapter boundary + first SFU backend (LiveKit/mediasoup) for group calls, region-aware room allocation, TURN, reconnect (spec:253-268, 436, 452, 460).
- Call control plane state machine (invite/ringing/join/leave) + server lifecycle + client SDK helpers (createCall/joinCall/leaveCall/useCallState) (spec:221-242, 329-338).
- Call presence (mic/camera/screenshare/speaking/network quality) (spec:237-242, 453).
- Optional E2EE via SFrame/MLS key epochs — explicitly deferred, design so it can be added (spec:51, 461).

Large; will need its own story breakdown. Size: L.
